title: Oral corticosteroids for post-infectious cough in adults: study protocol for a double-blind randomized placebo-controlled trial in Swiss family practices (OSPIC trial)
notes: This is a PROTOCOL, not a results paper. It is cited here only for its embedded summary of a prior systematic review (6 RCTs, no clear patient-relevant benefit). The trial RESULTS may now be published - locating them is a priority follow-up.
